In this video we cover:
Crisis in India’s Diamond Industry
India, which cuts and polishes 95% of the world’s diamonds, is facing its worst downturn in two decades. Exports have fallen sharply, jobs are being lost, and worker distress is rising. The crisis stems from global supply disruptions, collapsing Chinese demand, rising U.S. tariffs, and the growing popularity of cheaper lab-grown diamonds. With factories shutting down and companies relocating, the future of Surat’s diamond hub—and millions of livelihoods—hangs in the balance.
